label: Whatever has being by participation has an efficient cause of its esse other than itself
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every x that has its being by participation, some c other than x (numerical distinctness only) is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse c x, the tenseless agent-cause primitive of the q.3 a.4 efficiency profile). The efficient sibling of STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE (2b25a78c), whose cause of being has no fixed mode; neither entails the other by definition, since an efficient cause of esse is not defined to stand in CausesIn. It does not say that c is in act, that c is the only cause, or anything about present sustaining or time.
